newsitem.title: USA: U.S. must continue cutting deficit -- Gore.
newsitem.headline: U.S. must continue cutting deficit -- Gore.

text.p: Vice President Al Gore, calling the U.S. economy "the healthiest that it has been in a generation," said the United States must continue cutting the budget deficit, investing in education and opening trade.

"We must continue on this steady prosperous course by reducing the deficit, investing in education, the environment and technology and by seizing the benefits of open, free and fair reciprocal trade," he said at a White House briefing.
He urged Congress to pass a balanced budget plan, noting that lawmakers left for a Memorial Day recess before completing action on the budget.
"I want to call on Congress to keep growth alive and pass our balanced budget plan when members return to Washington," Gore said.
